project.name: Medical View
project.description: A cloud-native medical imaging and diagnosis platform where patients register and book checkups, doctors open a DICOM Viewport to diagnose a patient's Study (one DB row = one Study) under a single-writer distributed lock, save reports, and patients then receive results, prescriptions, drug purchases/billing, and follow-up appointments — built as .NET 10 microservices with Clean Architecture and deployed on Azure.

techStack.architecture: Clean Architecture + Microservices + Repository pattern + Unit of Work + SOLID
techStack.messaging: MassTransit over RabbitMQ (local) / Azure Service Bus (prod), Transactional Outbox
techStack.cloud: Azure (Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cache for Redis, Service Bus, Key Vault, ACR, Blob Storage, Application Insights)

sections.name: Foundation & Solution Structure
sections.goal: A compiling, conventioned monorepo with .NET 10 SDK, central package management, and Clean Architecture conventions agreed.

tasks.title: Install and verify .NET 10 SDK
tasks.details: Install the .NET 10 SDK on all dev machines/CI. Verify with `dotnet --list-sdks` and `dotnet --version` (expect 10.x).
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet --version` reports a 10.x SDK

tasks.title: Initialize git repository and .gitignore
tasks.details: Create the repo, run `dotnet new gitignore`, add README, LICENSE, and a CONTRIBUTING doc. Adopt trunk-based or GitFlow branching and document it.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo initialized with dotnet .gitignore and README committed

tasks.title: Create solution and top-level folders
tasks.details: Run `dotnet new sln -n MedicalView`. Create `src/`, `tests/`, `build/`, `deploy/`, `docs/` folders. Add solution folders per bounded context.
acceptanceCriteria: MedicalView.sln builds with `dotnet build` (empty)

tasks.title: Enable Central Package Management
tasks.details: Add `Directory.Packages.props` (CPM, `ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true`) and `Directory.Build.props` (nullable enable, LangVersion latest, ImplicitUsings, TreatWarningsAsErrors).
acceptanceCriteria: All projects resolve versions from Directory.Packages.props

tasks.title: Add .editorconfig and analyzers
tasks.details: Add `.editorconfig` with team code style, enable Roslyn analyzers and (optionally) StyleCop.Analyzers via CPM.
acceptanceCriteria: Style violations surface as build warnings/errors

tasks.title: Create dotnet tool manifest
tasks.details: Run `dotnet new tool-manifest` and `dotnet tool install dotnet-ef` so EF Core CLI is pinned per-repo.
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet ef --version` works via local tool manifest

tasks.title: Document Clean Architecture conventions
tasks.details: Write docs/architecture.md defining the 4 layers per service (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api), dependency rule (inward only), and folder naming.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/architecture.md reviewed and merged

sections.name: Shared Kernel & Building Blocks
sections.goal: Reusable building blocks (base entities, Result type, generic repository + Unit of Work, domain events, error handling, integration-event contracts) that every service consumes.

tasks.title: Create BuildingBlocks.Domain library
tasks.details: `dotnet new classlib` for Entity/AuditableEntity base, AggregateRoot, ValueObject, IDomainEvent, and strongly-typed Id support.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain primitives compile and are unit-testable

tasks.title: Implement Result and Error types
tasks.details: Add a Result / Result<T> and Error record for railway-style flow (avoid exceptions for expected failures). Include common error factories (NotFound, Conflict, Validation).
acceptanceCriteria: Result<T> supports success/failure with typed errors; unit tested

tasks.title: Define repository and Unit of Work abstractions
tasks.details: In BuildingBlocks.Application define IRepository<T>, IReadRepository<T>, ISpecification<T>, and IUnitOfWork. Depend on abstractions only (DIP).
acceptanceCriteria: Abstractions defined with no infrastructure dependency

tasks.title: Implement EF Core generic repository + UoW
tasks.details: Create BuildingBlocks.Infrastructure with EfRepository<T>, specification evaluator, and EfUnitOfWork wrapping DbContext.SaveChanges. Keep provider-agnostic.
acceptanceCriteria: Generic repo + UoW pass integration tests against a DbContext

tasks.title: Add domain event dispatch via MediatR
tasks.details: Register MediatR; dispatch IDomainEvent from SaveChanges interceptor after commit. Provide INotificationHandler base.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain events raised on an aggregate are handled after persistence

tasks.title: Global exception handling + ProblemDetails
tasks.details: Add exception-handling middleware mapping exceptions/Result errors to RFC7807 ProblemDetails with correlation id.
acceptanceCriteria: Unhandled/handled errors return consistent ProblemDetails JSON

tasks.title: Add validation pipeline (FluentValidation)
tasks.details: Add FluentValidation + a MediatR validation behavior so command/query inputs validate before handlers run.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid commands short-circuit with 400 + validation errors

tasks.title: Create Contracts library for integration events
tasks.details: Separate BuildingBlocks.Contracts package holding versioned integration-event records (UserRegistered, StudyLocked, ReportFinalized, PrescriptionIssued, BillPaid, FollowUpScheduled).
acceptanceCriteria: Contracts package referenced by publishers and consumers only

tasks.title: Add pagination and query result envelopes
tasks.details: Provide PagedResult<T>, paging request DTOs, and sorting helpers reused across query endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Paged endpoints share a single PagedResult<T> shape

sections.name: Local Infrastructure (Docker Compose / .NET Aspire)
sections.goal: One-command local environment: PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Seq running and reachable, with an optional .NET Aspire AppHost for orchestration.

tasks.title: Author docker-compose.yml for infrastructure
tasks.details: Create deploy/local/docker-compose.yml with services: postgres:17, redis:7, rabbitmq:3-management, datalust/seq. Add named volumes and a shared network.
acceptanceCriteria: `docker compose config` validates the file

tasks.title: Bring up the local stack
tasks.details: Run `docker compose -f deploy/local/docker-compose.yml up -d`. Confirm containers healthy with `docker compose ps` and `docker compose logs -f`.
acceptanceCriteria: All four containers report healthy/running

tasks.title: Verify individual services via CLI
tasks.details: Fallback single commands: `docker run -d --name mv-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=Pass@word1 -p 5432:5432 postgres:17`; `docker run -d --name mv-redis -p 6379:6379 redis:7`; `docker run -d --name mv-rabbitmq -p 5672:5672 -p 15672:15672 rabbitmq:3-management`; `docker run -d --name mv-seq -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -p 5341:80 datalust/seq`.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service reachable on its mapped port

tasks.title: Wire secrets with user-secrets and .env
tasks.details: Use `dotnet user-secrets` per service for connection strings/keys locally; provide a committed .env.example (no real secrets).
acceptanceCriteria: No secrets in source; .env.example documents required keys

tasks.title: Create optional .NET Aspire AppHost
tasks.details: Add an Aspire AppHost project to orchestrate services + containers with the dashboard; keep compose as the container-only fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet run` on AppHost starts services with Aspire dashboard

tasks.title: Add local admin UIs (optional)
tasks.details: Optionally add pgAdmin and RedisInsight containers; document RabbitMQ management UI at http://localhost:15672 and Seq at http://localhost:5341.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin UIs reachable and documented in docs/local.md

sections.name: Auth Microservice
sections.goal: A standalone Auth service issuing JWT access + refresh tokens over ASP.NET Core Identity, publishing UserRegistered, and exposing a shared token-validation config.

tasks.title: Scaffold Auth service in Clean Architecture
tasks.details: Create Auth.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects wired with BuildingBlocks. `dotnet new webapi` for Api (minimal APIs or controllers).
acceptanceCriteria: Auth service builds and runs with a health endpoint

tasks.title: Add ASP.NET Core Identity + EF Core (Npgsql)
tasks.details: Configure Identity user/store on PostgreSQL via Npgsql. Add DbContext, run `dotnet ef migrations add InitAuth` and `dotnet ef database update`.
acceptanceCriteria: Users table created in Postgres via EF migration

tasks.title: Implement JWT access + refresh token issuance
tasks.details: Add token service (signing key from config/Key Vault), access token with role/permission claims, rotating refresh tokens with persistence and revocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Login returns access+refresh; refresh rotates and revokes old token

tasks.title: Build Register / Login / Refresh / Logout endpoints
tasks.details: Expose endpoints with FluentValidation, password policy, and Identity lockout on repeated failures.
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end register->login->refresh->logout works

tasks.title: Publish UserRegistered integration event
tasks.details: On successful registration, publish UserRegistered via the message bus (see S16 bus setup) using the Outbox pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: UserRegistered observed on the broker after registration

tasks.title: Export shared JWT validation configuration
tasks.details: Provide a shared AddJwtAuth() extension (issuer, audience, signing key) consumed by every downstream service and the gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: A protected test endpoint accepts Auth-issued tokens

tasks.title: Write Auth unit + integration tests
tasks.details: Unit test token service and handlers; integration test endpoints against a Postgres Testcontainer.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth test suite green in CI

sections.name: Role & Permission Microservice
sections.goal: Central role/permission management with policy-based authorization, default seeded roles (Patient, Doctor, Admin), and permission claims flowing into JWTs.

tasks.title: Scaffold Role service (Clean Architecture)
tasks.details: Create Role.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects and DbContext on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Role service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model roles, permissions, and assignments
tasks.details: Domain: Role, Permission, RolePermission, UserRole. Add EF config + `dotnet ef migrations add InitRole`.
acceptanceCriteria: Role/permission schema migrated to Postgres

tasks.title: Implement permission-based authorization
tasks.details: Add a custom IAuthorizationPolicyProvider + permission requirement/handler so `[HasPermission("studies.read")]` works across services.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints enforce fine-grained permissions

tasks.title: Feed permissions into JWT claims
tasks.details: Coordinate with Auth so effective permissions are embedded as claims at token issuance (or resolved via a claims transformation).
acceptanceCriteria: JWT carries permission claims used by policies

tasks.title: Seed default roles and permissions
tasks.details: Seed Patient, Doctor, Admin with baseline permissions on startup (idempotent seeder).
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh DB contains the three default roles

tasks.title: Admin endpoints for role management
tasks.details: CRUD for roles/permissions and assign/unassign to users, guarded by admin permission.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can manage roles via API with authorization

tasks.title: Role service tests
tasks.details: Unit test policy provider/handler; integration test admin endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Role test suite green

sections.name: Patient & Studies Microservice
sections.goal: The core clinical record service: Patients and Studies (each row = one Study) with multi-doctor assignment, a status enum including Locked, and full audit history.

tasks.title: Scaffold Patient/Studies service
tasks.details: Create Patients.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres with BuildingBlocks wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model Patient and Study aggregates
tasks.details: Study is an aggregate root with StudyStatus enum (Registered, InReview, Locked, Reported, Closed), AuditableEntity fields, and assigned-doctors collection.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain enforces status transitions via methods

tasks.title: Persist with EF Core + migrations
tasks.details: Configure mappings and run `dotnet ef migrations add InitPatients`; apply owned-type/value-object mappings.
acceptanceCriteria: Patients + Studies tables created in Postgres

tasks.title: Assign multiple doctors to a Study
tasks.details: Command to add/remove doctor assignments to a Study (many doctors allowed) with permission checks.
acceptanceCriteria: A Study can list multiple assigned doctors

tasks.title: Query endpoints for Studies list
tasks.details: Paged/filterable Studies list and Study detail endpoints using the specification pattern and PagedResult<T>.
acceptanceCriteria: Studies list returns paged, filtered results

tasks.title: Implement audit history
tasks.details: Record who changed what/when for Studies (audit log table or EF Core temporal tables) to satisfy compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Study change produces an audit record

tasks.title: Consume UserRegistered to create Patient profile
tasks.details: Subscribe to UserRegistered and create/link a Patient profile idempotently.
acceptanceCriteria: New user results in a Patient profile

tasks.title: Patient/Studies tests
tasks.details: Unit test status transitions and assignment rules; integration test query endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green including audit assertions

sections.name: Appointment / Booking Microservice
sections.goal: Checkup booking with availability, plus follow-up appointment scheduling triggered after a report is finalized.

tasks.title: Scaffold Booking service
tasks.details: Create Booking.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model Appointment, Slot, and FollowUp
tasks.details: Domain for appointment lifecycle (Requested, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled) + availability slots. Add EF migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Appointment schema migrated; transitions enforced

tasks.title: Booking + availability endpoints
tasks.details: Allow a patient to view availability and book a checkup; prevent double-booking with concurrency checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Patient can book an available slot; conflicts rejected

tasks.title: Follow-up scheduling from report
tasks.details: Consume ReportFinalized to offer/schedule a follow-up appointment date and publish FollowUpScheduled.
acceptanceCriteria: Finalized report enables a follow-up booking

tasks.title: Emit AppointmentBooked event
tasks.details: Publish AppointmentBooked (Outbox) for notification.
acceptanceCriteria: AppointmentBooked observed on broker

tasks.title: Booking tests
tasks.details: Unit test slot/conflict logic; integration test booking flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: DICOM Imaging Microservice
sections.goal: Ingest, store, and serve DICOM: pixel data in Azure Blob Storage, metadata in the DB, linked to Studies, with DICOMweb-style (STOW/WADO/QIDO) endpoints via fo-dicom.

tasks.title: Scaffold Imaging service + add fo-dicom
tasks.details: Create Imaging.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects; add the fo-dicom package for parsing/serialization.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs; fo-dicom parses a sample .dcm

tasks.title: Configure blob + metadata storage
tasks.details: Store pixel data in Azure Blob Storage (Azurite locally) and DICOM metadata in Postgres. Add EF migration for image/instance metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploaded DICOM stored in blob with metadata row

tasks.title: Implement STOW (store) endpoint
tasks.details: Accept DICOM upload, validate, extract metadata, persist, and associate with a Study id.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploaded instance linked to its Study

tasks.title: Implement WADO (retrieve) + QIDO (query)
tasks.details: Serve instances/frames (WADO-RS) and query studies/series/instances (QIDO-RS).
acceptanceCriteria: Client can query and retrieve stored instances

tasks.title: Generate thumbnails / frame rendering
tasks.details: Produce cached preview images/frames (fo-dicom rendering) for fast viewport loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Thumbnail retrievable for a stored instance

tasks.title: Imaging tests
tasks.details: Unit test metadata extraction; integration test store/retrieve against Azurite + Postgres Testcontainers.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: Viewport Concurrency & Single-Doctor Distributed Lock
sections.goal: Enforce that only one Doctor edits a Study's Viewport at a time using a Redis distributed lock with ownership, TTL/heartbeat, and safe release; expose lock status to the UI.

tasks.title: Add Redis connection + RedLock
tasks.details: Wire StackExchange.Redis and RedLock.net (or a Redlock implementation) into a shared LockService abstraction (ILockService).
acceptanceCriteria: LockService connects to Redis and acquires a test lock

tasks.title: Acquire lock on Viewport open
tasks.details: When a Doctor opens a Study viewport, acquire a lock keyed by study id with the doctor id as owner and a short TTL.
acceptanceCriteria: First doctor acquires; Study status set to Locked

tasks.title: Heartbeat / auto-renew while active
tasks.details: Renew the lock via heartbeat while the doctor is active so it does not expire mid-session; stop renewing on idle.
acceptanceCriteria: Lock stays held during active use, expires after inactivity

tasks.title: Reject non-owners from write access
tasks.details: Any write/report action requires being the current lock owner; others receive 409 Conflict with owner info.
acceptanceCriteria: Second doctor is denied viewport write with clear conflict

tasks.title: Safe release on close/timeout
tasks.details: Release lock on explicit close, logout, or TTL expiry; ensure only the owner can release (fencing token).
acceptanceCriteria: Lock released only by owner; auto-released on timeout

tasks.title: Lock status API + events
tasks.details: Expose GET lock-status for a Study and publish StudyLocked/StudyUnlocked events for UI/notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: UI can query who holds a Study and react to events

tasks.title: Concurrency tests for the lock
tasks.details: Integration tests simulating concurrent doctors against a Redis Testcontainer, including expiry and fencing.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent-access tests prove single-writer guarantee

sections.name: Reporting / Diagnosis Microservice
sections.goal: Doctors write and finalize a diagnosis Report against a Study (only the lock owner may write); finalized reports notify the patient and unlock downstream flows.

tasks.title: Scaffold Reporting service
tasks.details: Create Reporting.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model Report and Diagnosis
tasks.details: Report aggregate linked to Study with Draft/Finalized states and diagnosis fields. Add EF migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Report schema migrated; state machine enforced

tasks.title: Enforce lock ownership on write
tasks.details: Save/update report only if the caller currently owns the Study lock (call ILockService/lock-status).
acceptanceCriteria: Non-owners cannot create or edit a report

tasks.title: Draft save + finalize endpoints
tasks.details: Allow incremental draft saves and a finalize action that transitions the Study to Reported.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft->Finalize flow updates Study status

tasks.title: Publish ReportFinalized event
tasks.details: On finalize, publish ReportFinalized (Outbox) consumed by Booking, Prescription, and Notification.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportFinalized observed on broker

tasks.title: Generate PDF report (optional)
tasks.details: Render the finalized report to PDF and store it (blob) for patient download.
acceptanceCriteria: Finalized report downloadable as PDF

tasks.title: Reporting tests
tasks.details: Unit test state machine + ownership guard; integration test finalize + event emission.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: Prescription Microservice
sections.goal: Create prescriptions from a finalized report, referencing a drug catalog, and publish PrescriptionIssued for the cart/billing flow.

tasks.title: Scaffold Prescription service
tasks.details: Create Prescription.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model Prescription + items + drug catalog
tasks.details: Prescription aggregate with PrescriptionItem lines referencing a Drug catalog. Add EF migration and seed a sample catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: Prescription schema migrated; catalog seeded

tasks.title: Create prescription from finalized report
tasks.details: Consume ReportFinalized (or a doctor action) to create a prescription tied to the report/patient.
acceptanceCriteria: Finalized report can yield a prescription

tasks.title: Publish PrescriptionIssued
tasks.details: Publish PrescriptionIssued (Outbox) so Cart can offer the drugs for purchase.
acceptanceCriteria: PrescriptionIssued observed on broker

tasks.title: Prescription tests
tasks.details: Unit test creation rules; integration test event-driven creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: Cart & Billing / Payment Microservice
sections.goal: Patients add prescribed drugs to a cart, check out to create a bill, complete payment (test gateway), and receive order history; publishes BillPaid.

tasks.title: Scaffold Cart/Billing service
tasks.details: Create Cart.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Model Cart, Order, and Invoice
tasks.details: Cart with line items, Order, Invoice/Bill with totals and payment status. Add EF migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart/Order/Invoice schema migrated

tasks.title: Populate cart from prescription
tasks.details: Consume PrescriptionIssued so prescribed drugs can be added to the patient's cart.
acceptanceCriteria: Prescribed drugs appear as add-to-cart options

tasks.title: Checkout creates a bill
tasks.details: Checkout converts the cart to an order and generates an invoice with computed totals/taxes.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout produces an invoice with correct totals

tasks.title: Integrate payment (test gateway)
tasks.details: Integrate Stripe test mode (or a mock provider) to complete payment; handle webhook/confirmation idempotently.
acceptanceCriteria: A test payment marks the bill Paid

tasks.title: Publish BillPaid + order history
tasks.details: On payment success publish BillPaid (Outbox) and expose an order-history endpoint for the patient.
acceptanceCriteria: BillPaid emitted; history endpoint returns orders

tasks.title: Cart/Billing tests
tasks.details: Unit test totals/state; integration test checkout + payment confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: Notification Microservice
sections.goal: React to domain events (report ready, appointment booked, bill paid, follow-up scheduled) and notify patients via email/SMS with templated messages and a delivery log.

tasks.title: Scaffold Notification service
tasks.details: Create Notification.Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects on Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: Service runs with health endpoint

tasks.title: Subscribe to domain events
tasks.details: Consume ReportFinalized, AppointmentBooked, BillPaid, FollowUpScheduled from the bus.
acceptanceCriteria: Each event triggers a notification workflow

tasks.title: Integrate email/SMS provider
tasks.details: Integrate Azure Communication Services or SendGrid for email (and optional SMS) with templated content.
acceptanceCriteria: A test event sends a templated email

tasks.title: Persist a notification/delivery log
tasks.details: Record sent notifications, status, and retries for audit and troubleshooting.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications are logged with delivery status

tasks.title: Notification tests
tasks.details: Unit test template selection; integration test event->send with a mocked provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Suite green

sections.name: API Gateway (YARP)
sections.goal: A single ingress via YARP with per-service routing, JWT auth forwarding, rate limiting, CORS, and aggregated health.

tasks.title: Create YARP gateway project
tasks.details: `dotnet new web` gateway; add YARP reverse proxy package and base configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway starts and proxies a sample route

tasks.title: Configure routes and clusters per service
tasks.details: Map routes to Auth, Role, Patients, Booking, Imaging, Reporting, Prescription, Cart, Notification clusters.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service reachable behind the gateway path

tasks.title: Enforce JWT auth at the edge
tasks.details: Validate tokens at the gateway (shared AddJwtAuth) and forward identity/claims downstream.
acceptanceCriteria: Protected routes require a valid token at the gateway

tasks.title: Add rate limiting and CORS
tasks.details: Apply ASP.NET Core rate limiting policies and a CORS policy for the Blazor origin.
acceptanceCriteria: Excess requests are throttled; Blazor origin allowed

tasks.title: Aggregate health and expose OpenAPI
tasks.details: Add health-check aggregation and (optionally) a unified OpenAPI/Swagger surface.
acceptanceCriteria: /health reflects downstream service health

sections.name: Blazor Front-end (Patient & Doctor portals + DICOM Viewport)
sections.goal: A Blazor Web App delivering the Patient journey (register, book, view report, prescription, cart/checkout, follow-up) and the Doctor journey (studies list, viewport with lock indicator, write report), with a Cornerstone.js DICOM viewer.

tasks.title: Create Blazor Web App project
tasks.details: `dotnet new blazor` (interactive auto/server render modes) targeting .NET 10; configure the typed API client against the gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: App runs and calls a gateway endpoint

tasks.title: Implement authentication in the UI
tasks.details: Handle login/refresh token storage, auth state provider, and protected routes/role-based UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Login persists session; protected pages gated

tasks.title: Build the Patient portal
tasks.details: Pages for register, book checkup, view final report, view prescription, cart/checkout, and follow-up scheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: Patient can complete the end-to-end journey in the UI

tasks.title: Build the Doctor portal + studies list
tasks.details: Studies list with filters and a Study detail page showing assignment and status.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor sees assigned Studies and can open one

tasks.title: Integrate DICOM Viewport (Cornerstone.js)
tasks.details: Add JS interop to render DICOM (Cornerstone.js) in the Doctor viewport, loading frames via the Imaging service (WADO).
acceptanceCriteria: DICOM images render and can be windowed/zoomed

tasks.title: Surface lock status + report editor
tasks.details: Show LOCKED indicator and owner; allow only the lock owner to edit/save the report from the viewport.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-owner viewport is read-only with clear lock UI

tasks.title: Real-time lock updates (SignalR, optional)
tasks.details: Push lock acquire/release updates to connected doctors via SignalR for instant UI feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Lock changes reflect without manual refresh

tasks.title: UI error handling + loading states
tasks.details: Consistent handling of ProblemDetails errors, 409 conflicts, and loading/empty states.
acceptanceCriteria: Errors and conflicts render friendly messages

sections.name: Cross-cutting: Messaging, Observability & Resilience
sections.goal: Shared async messaging (MassTransit + Outbox), structured logging (Serilog), distributed tracing/metrics (OpenTelemetry), health checks, and resilience (Polly) across all services.

tasks.title: Set up MassTransit with RabbitMQ
tasks.details: Add a shared messaging extension configuring MassTransit over RabbitMQ locally (Azure Service Bus in prod) with consumer registration.
acceptanceCriteria: A test message publishes and is consumed

tasks.title: Implement the Transactional Outbox
tasks.details: Enable MassTransit EF Core Outbox so events publish atomically with the local DB transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Events are not lost on partial failures

tasks.title: Add Serilog structured logging
tasks.details: Configure Serilog with enrichers (correlation id, service name) and sinks to console + Seq locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Logs are structured and visible in Seq

tasks.title: Add OpenTelemetry tracing + metrics
tasks.details: Instrument ASP.NET Core, HttpClient, EF Core, Redis, and MassTransit; export traces/metrics (OTLP) and propagate context across the bus.
acceptanceCriteria: A request trace spans gateway->service->bus

tasks.title: Add health checks everywhere
tasks.details: Add liveness/readiness checks (DB, Redis, broker, downstream) to every service and the gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: /health/ready reflects real dependency health

tasks.title: Apply Polly resilience policies
tasks.details: Add retry, timeout, and circuit-breaker policies to HttpClient calls and message consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: Transient failures retry; breakers open under sustained failure

sections.name: Security & Compliance
sections.goal: Health-data-grade security: TLS everywhere, secrets in Key Vault, encryption at rest, PII protection, audit logging, least-privilege identities, and GDPR/HIPAA-minded data handling.

tasks.title: Enforce HTTPS/TLS and security headers
tasks.details: Require HTTPS, enable HSTS, and add security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.) at the gateway and services.
acceptanceCriteria: Traffic is TLS-only with hardened headers

tasks.title: Centralize secrets in Key Vault
tasks.details: Move connection strings/keys to Azure Key Vault referenced via managed identity; remove secrets from config/repo.
acceptanceCriteria: No secrets in code; services read from Key Vault

tasks.title: Encrypt data at rest + protect PII
tasks.details: Enable DB/Blob encryption at rest and add field-level encryption/hashing for sensitive PII where needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive fields encrypted; storage encrypted at rest

tasks.title: Implement access audit logging
tasks.details: Log who accessed/modified which Study/report (immutable audit trail) for compliance investigations.
acceptanceCriteria: Study access/edits produce audit entries

tasks.title: Least-privilege identities and RBAC
tasks.details: Use managed identities and scoped RBAC so each service has only the Azure permissions it needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service uses a scoped managed identity

tasks.title: GDPR/HIPAA data-handling controls
tasks.details: Add data-retention policy and a right-to-erasure workflow; document data-processing and lawful basis.
acceptanceCriteria: Retention + erasure workflow documented and testable

tasks.title: Dependency and container scanning
tasks.details: Enable dependency vulnerability scanning and image scanning in CI (see S19).
acceptanceCriteria: Vulnerable dependencies/images flagged in CI

sections.name: Testing (Unit, Integration, Contract, E2E)
sections.goal: A layered test strategy with coverage gates: unit tests for domain/application, Testcontainers integration tests, consumer-driven contract tests, and Playwright E2E for the Blazor flows.

tasks.title: Establish test projects and conventions
tasks.details: Add xUnit + FluentAssertions + NSubstitute test projects per service and a shared test utilities library.
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet test` discovers and runs all suites

tasks.title: Write domain/application unit tests
tasks.details: Cover aggregates, state machines (Study status, report finalize), and handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical domain logic covered by unit tests

tasks.title: Integration tests with Testcontainers
tasks.details: Spin up Postgres/Redis/RabbitMQ/Azurite via Testcontainers for repository, lock, and messaging tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests run against real containers in CI

tasks.title: Consumer-driven contract tests
tasks.details: Add Pact (or similar) contracts between event publishers/consumers and gateway/service HTTP contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Breaking contract changes fail the build

tasks.title: End-to-end tests (Playwright)
tasks.details: Automate key journeys: patient booking->report->prescription->payment, and doctor lock/report flow.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E covers the two primary journeys

tasks.title: Coverage gate + load test the lock
tasks.details: Add Coverlet coverage thresholds; add a k6/NBomber load test proving single-writer under concurrency.
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage gate enforced; lock holds under load

sections.name: CI/CD Pipeline
sections.goal: Automated build/test on PRs and gated deployment: containerize each service, scan and push to ACR, run migrations, and deploy to Azure with environment approvals.

tasks.title: CI workflow: build + test on PR
tasks.details: GitHub Actions workflow restoring, building, and running `dotnet test` (with Testcontainers) on every pull request.
acceptanceCriteria: PRs are blocked unless build + tests pass

tasks.title: Containerize each service
tasks.details: Add multi-stage Dockerfiles (or `dotnet publish` container build) for every service and the gateway/Blazor app.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service produces a runnable image locally

tasks.title: Scan and push images to ACR
tasks.details: Add image vulnerability scanning (e.g., Trivy) then push tagged images to Azure Container Registry.
acceptanceCriteria: Scanned images published to ACR on main

tasks.title: Automate database migrations
tasks.details: Run EF Core migrations as a pipeline step or startup migrator with safeguards for production.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations apply automatically per environment

tasks.title: CD workflow with environment approvals
tasks.details: Deploy to dev/staging/prod (Azure Container Apps) with manual approval gates and environment secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: Promotion to prod requires approval

tasks.title: Smoke tests post-deploy
tasks.details: Run health/smoke checks after each deployment and auto-rollback or alert on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed smoke checks block/rollback the release

sections.name: Azure Infrastructure (IaC) & Production Deployment
sections.goal: All Azure resources provisioned via Bicep and the system running in production on Azure Container Apps with managed identities, private networking, autoscaling, monitoring, and cost controls.

tasks.title: Author Bicep modules for core resources
tasks.details: Create Bicep for Resource Group, ACR, Container Apps Environment, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
acceptanceCriteria: `az deployment` provisions core resources

tasks.title: Provision data + messaging resources
tasks.details: Bicep for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Service Bus, and Blob Storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Data/cache/bus/storage provisioned via IaC

tasks.title: Provision Key Vault + managed identities
tasks.details: Bicep for Key Vault and user-assigned managed identities with scoped RBAC role assignments per service.
acceptanceCriteria: Services authenticate to Azure via managed identity

tasks.title: Deploy Container Apps with config
tasks.details: Deploy each service/gateway/Blazor app as a Container App, wiring Key Vault references and Service Bus/Redis/Postgres connections.
acceptanceCriteria: All apps run in the Container Apps environment

tasks.title: Networking and private endpoints
tasks.details: Add VNet integration and private endpoints for Postgres/Redis/Key Vault/Storage; restrict public access.
acceptanceCriteria: Data services are not publicly reachable

tasks.title: Autoscaling, custom domain, and TLS
tasks.details: Configure Container Apps scale rules (HTTP/queue length), a custom domain, and managed TLS certificates.
acceptanceCriteria: Apps autoscale; custom domain served over TLS

tasks.title: Monitoring dashboards + cost alerts
tasks.details: Build App Insights/Log Analytics dashboards and alerts (errors, latency, lock contention) and set budget/cost alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboards live; alerts fire on threshold breaches

tasks.title: Production runbook + DR plan
tasks.details: Document deploy/rollback runbook, backup/restore for Postgres/Blob, and a disaster-recovery/RTO-RPO plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Runbook + DR plan reviewed and stored in docs/
